workedExamples.prompt: Read “night”. What happens to gh in this taught pattern?
workedExamples.solution: The gh is not pronounced; read the word /n/ /ī/ /t/.

workedExamples.prompt: A learner writes lite for light. What should be checked?
workedExamples.solution: The conventional spelling is light, including silent gh.

workedExamples.prompt: Why try a fresh example after guided practice?
workedExamples.solution: A new item checks whether the learner can use the skill independently.
